name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated resource of approximately 199 million ounces of silver and 1.7 million ounces of gold. The company completed a Pre-Feasibility Study and received environmental approval in 2026, positioning it as a developer transitioning toward a construction decision.
